rent.notes: 2026 guide: furnished 1BR in El Rodadero/Centro COP 1.8-3.2M, 2BR beachfront condos in Bello Horizonte/Pozos Colorados COP 3.5-7.0M+ (USD 1,115-2,230+); IL (2019) 3BR/2BA USD 400-1,000. Typical set for an unfurnished pet-friendly 2-3BR off the beachfront condo market. TRM 3,183.
